'''Nilsa Skaller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Nilsa Skaller]]
Nilsa Skaller was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Nilsa Skaller spawned under the generic "assassin" template, her appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Skaller could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either gender. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Skaller as female, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
